items.content_html:
Description of Changes

This PR is an extension to an older PR by @drupol.

The original PR established a basic Drupal package and NixOS service, but the author wasn't able to complete it due to time constraints. This PR (with drupol's blessing) builds on top of the original service and package definition to make a more streamlined implementation, similar in spirit to how the existing WordPress/NixOS implementation works.

I've updated Drupal from 10.3.1 to 11.1.7, added a default webserver and mysql server config, added in a user-manageable state directory, and made it so that the NixOS service is installable using composer and can serve HTTP requests from localhost.

Users need only add

services.drupal.enable = true;

to their configuration.nix, and a shiny new Drupal site will be available at localhost. Furthermore, they can update settings from /var/lib/drupal/localhost. Users wishing to access this directory without sudo can simply add themselves to the webserver group (either nginx or caddy to their user group. nginx is the default webserver).

items.content_html:
Ente.io is an application to host an end-to-end encrypted platform for photos and videos. This PR adds a NixOS module to host the ente stack, a nixos test and a documentation page. The module consists of the API server (museum) and several SPA web frontends (nginx). These can be hosted independently of one another.

Specifically this will host:

  • photos (the main app)
  • accounts (passkeys)
  • albums (shared albums)
  • cast (TV casting)

This does not host:

  • billing / payments
  • families (family plan management)

items.content_html:
This PR introduces NixOS modules for FirewallD.
There are 3 main parts:

  • services.firewalld, which allows for declarative configuration of firewalld; and
  • networking.firewall.firewalld, which will create a default zone name nixos with many existing configurations from networking.firewall.
  • NetworkManager now installs firewalld zone nm-shared.

What's not done:

  • Configuration for files other than zones and services
  • /etc/firewall/applet.conf
  • networking.firewall.backend as a enum, current approach is complicated
  • NetworkManager integration

    nixpkgs/pkgs/tools/networking/networkmanager/default.nix

    Lines 121 to 122 in 2631b0b

    # We don't use firewalld in NixOS
    "-Dfirewalld_zone=false"

Related to https://git.sr.ht/~prince213/firewalld-nix.
Related to #389437.
Closes #165882.
Supersedes #205380.
